questions.question: The simple interest on a certain sum at 12% per annum for 3 years is Rs. 4,140. What is the compound interest on the same sum at 8% for two years?
questions.solution:
Let the amount invested be x,

Simple interest earned on it = (x × 12 × 3) /100 = 4140

⇒ x = (4140 × 100) / (12 × 3)

⇒ x = 11500

Compound interest earned on it for 2 years at 8% = 11500(1 + 8/100)² – 11500

⇒ CI = 11500(1.08)² – 11500

∴ CI = Rs. 1,913.60

questions.question: The mass number of an isotope of an element is 298. If its nucleus has 188 neutrons, what is its atomic number?
questions.solution:
• The mass number of an element (A) = 298
 
• Number of Neutrons (n) = 188
 
• A mass number of an element = number of protons + number of neutrons.
 
• Number of protons (p) = atomic number (Z)
 
• Therefore, the total atomic number Z = 298 – 188

Z = 110.

 
• Its atomic number (Z) = 110.

questions.question: In 540 grams of glucose, the number of moles present is:
questions.solution:
• Number of grams of glucose = 540 gm
 
• We know that the molecular formula of glucose = C₆H₁₂O₆
 
• Molecular mass is the sum of total protons and neutrons
 
• The molecular mass of carbon = 6 × 2 = 12
 
• The molecular mass of Hydrogen = 1 × 1 = 1
 
• The molecular mass of Oxygen = 8 × 2 = 16
 
• Now multiply the mass with number of elements we get = (6 × 12 = 72, 12 × 1 = 12, 16 × 6 = 96) = 180
 
• One mole is equal to the total mass of the molecule
 
• We know one mole is equal to 180 gm of Glucose molecule.
 
• Now the number of moles in 540 gm of glucose is (n) = 540/180

n = 3 moles

 
• The number of moles in 540 gm is 3 moles.

questions.question: Priyankur's present age is seven years less than thrice the age of his cousin Rihana. Sixteen years from now Priyankur’s age will be 150% of that of Rihana. What is Priyankur's present age (in years)?
questions.solution:

Let the present age of Rihana be x

So, according to question

Age of Priyankur = 3x - 7

16 years from now,

3x - 7 + 16 = 150% of (x + 16)

⇒ 3x + 9 = (3/2) of (x + 16)

⇒ 6x + 18 = 3x + 48

⇒ 3x = 30

⇒ x = 10

∴ Priyankur's present age = 3x - 7 = 23 years

questions.question: What is the measure of the smaller of the two angles formed between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock when it is 6:44 p.m.?
questions.solution:
The angle between the hour hand and the minute hand when the clock shows 6.44 pm can be calculated using the following formula:

Angle =| {11{} over 2}M – 30 H |

Where, M = minutes and H = hours

Here, M = 44, H = 6

Therefore, we get angle= | {11{} over 2}× 44 – 30 × 6 | = |242 – 180| = |62°| = 62°

Hence, 62° is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a parallel circuit, if one electrical appliance stops working due to some defect, then all the other appliances:

will keep working half of what they did

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**will work normally**__.

__
 
• **In a parallel circuit even if one electrical appliance stops working due to some defect all the other appliances will work normally**__.

• It means in a parallel circuit there are multiple ways for charge flow.
 
• Hence even if one load malfunctions it does not affect the other appliances as charge can still flow to them.

questions.question: Which of the numbers given below is exactly divisible by 12?
questions.solution:
For a number to be divisible by 12, it should be divisible by 4 and 3.

For 57816,

5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 = 27, which is a multiple of 3, hence the number is divisible by 3.

Also, for any number to be divisible by 2ⁿ, the last n digits should be divisible by 2ⁿ

Here, for 57816 to be divisible by 2² = 4, the last two digits i.e. 16 should be divisible by 4.

Hence the number is divisible by 4 also.

∴ 57816 is divisible by 12.

questions.question: A pump can fill a tank in 4 hours, but due to a leak, the tank now gets filled in 5 hours. How long will it take the leakage to empty the tank when it is full?
questions.solution:
Let the total amount of work done in filling a tank be 20 units. (L.C.M of 4 and 5)

A pump can fill a tank in 4 hours,

⇒ Work done by pump in 1 hour = 20/4 = 5 units.

Due to a leak, the tank now gets filled in 5 hours,

⇒ Work done by Pump and Leakage together in 1 hour = 20/5 = 4 units.

⇒ Work done by leakage in 1 hour = -1 units.

∴ Time required for leakage to empty the tank = -20/-1 = 20 hours.

questions.question: If the initial velocity of an object thrown upwards is 14 m/s, then the time taken for the object to reach its highest point will be_______. (a = 9.8 m/s²)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1.43 sec.

 
• Initial Velocity of an object though up (u) = 14 m/s
 
• Acceleration against gravity (a) = -9.81 m/s² 
 
• When the object reaches maximum height while thrown upwards its final velocity (v) = 0
 
• We know the formula v = u + at

⇒ 14 + (-9.8) (t)) = 0

⇒ t = 14/9.8

⇒ t = 1.42 ≈ 1.43

Time taken for the object to reach its highest point will be 1.43 s

questions.question: If a boy covers a distance of 20 metre in 4 minutes with a force of 600 N, then the power consumed by the boy is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**50 W**__.

 
• Distance covered by the boy (d) = 20 m
 
• Time is taken by the boy (t) = 4 min ⇒ 240 s
 
• Force (F) = 600 Newtons
 
• We know that work = Force × distance

= F × d

= 600 × 20

W = 12000 N-m (Newton-Meter)

questions.question: Mean temperature of a city for a week is 28°C. If the mean temperature for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday is 27.5°C and the mean temperature for Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday is 29°C, then the temperature recorded on Thursday is:
questions.solution:
⇒ Summation of temperatures for Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday = 27.5 × 4 = 110

⇒ Summation of temperatures for a week = 28 × 7 = 196

⇒ Summation of temperatures for Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday = 29 × 4 = 116

⇒ Summation of temperatures for a week = Summation of temperature for Mon, Tue, Wed, Thurs +

Summation of temperatures for Thurs, Fri, Sat, Sunday – Temperature on Thursday

⇒ 196 = 110 + 116 – Thursday Temperature

∴ Thursday Temperature = 30°C

questions.question: Select the INCORRECT set of Molecular Formula - IUPAC Name - Common Name from the following options.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **C3H8OH - Propanol - Propyl Alcohol**

**Concept:-**

**Molecular Formula:** A molecular formula denotes the type and number of atoms in a single molecule of a compound. It is a concise way to describe the exact composition of a molecule. For instance, in (methanol) CH₃OH, C denotes carbon, H is for hydrogen, and O stands for oxygen. The subscript indicates the number of each type of atom in the molecule.

**IUPAC Naming**: The International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC) developed a system for naming chemical compounds. This system is used to ensure that each compound has a unique name, thereby avoiding the confusion that can arise from the use of common names. For example, the IUPAC name for C₂H₅OH is ethanol.

**Common Names**: Besides IUPAC names, many chemical compounds are also known by common names, which are often derived from their historical or traditional names. These names are widely used, but they can sometimes result in confusion as the same compound can have different common names in different regions or contexts. For example, C₂H₅OH is widely known as ethyl alcohol in addition to its IUPAC name, ethanol.

**Explanation:-**

The simplified molecular formula for propanol would be C3H7OH, not C₃H₈OH. The first option is incorrect. Let's look at the correct formulas:

C₃H₇OH - Propanol - Propyl alcohol

C₂H₅OH - Ethanol - Ethyl alcohol

C₄H₉OH - Butanol - Butyl alcohol

CH₃OH - Methanol - Methyl alcohol

Therefore, the INCORRECT set of Molecular Formula - IUPAC Name - Common Name among the given options is:

**C3H8OH - Propanol - Propyl alcohol**

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of task together in 12 days, while A alone can do it in 15 days. They start working together but A leaves 10 days before the completion of the task. For how many days did A and B work together?
questions.solution:
Let the amount of the work = 60 units.

A and B can complete a piece of task together in 12 days,

⇒ Amount of work A and B complete in a day = 60/12 = 5 units

A alone can do it in 15 days,

⇒ Amount of work A completes in a day = 60/15 = 4 units.

⇒ Amount of work B completes in a day = 5 – 4 = 1 unit.

Assume they work together for x day, then A leaves and B works alone for 10 days.

⇒ 5(x) + 10(1) = 60

⇒ 5x = 50

⇒ x = 10

∴ For 10 days A and B work together.

questions.question: The base of a triangle is five-sixth of the base of a parallelogram having the same area as that of the triangle. The ratio of the corresponding heights of the triangle to the parallelogram will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Triangle (base) = 5/6 Parallelogram (base)

Area of triangle = Area of parallelogram

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

Area of parallelogram = base × height

**Calculation:**

Let the height of triangle and parallelogram be h and H respectively.

Let the base of parallelogram be x, the base of triangle is 5x/6.

Area of triangle = Area of parallelogram

⇒ 1/2 × base × height = base × height

⇒ 1/2 × 5x/6 × h = x × H

∴ h/H = 6/5 × 2 = 12/5 = 12 ∶ 5

• Velocity of the waves (v) = 25 m/s
 
• We know that velocity v = λ/t where t = time

t = λ/v

 
• Now substituting the above value, we get

t = 125 / 25

time (t) = 5

 
• We know that frequency (f) = 1/t

We get f = 1/5

= 0. 20 Hz.

 
• Hence, we get the frequency of the boat **(f) = 0.20 Hz.**__

questions.question: When a force of 10 N acts on a body of the mass of 10 kg that is able to move freely, which of the following statements will apply?

options.text: The body moves with a speed of 1 km/s
The body moves with an acceleration of 10 ms⁻²
The body moves with an acceleration of 1 ms⁻²
The body moves with a speed of 1 m/s

questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Force: The interaction which after applying on a body changes or try to change the state of rest or state of motion of the body is called force.

Force (F) = Mass (m) × acceleration (a)

**CALCULATION**__:

Given data:

The force acting on the body (F) = 10 N

Mass of the body (m) = 10 kg

Acceleration of the body (a) =?

From the Newton Second law, we get F = ma

a = F/m

Now by substituting above values, we get

a = 10/10 = 1 m/s²

Hence, we get acceleration (a) = 1.

 
• The **body moves with an acceleration of 1 m/s².**
